verdict.rationale: Controlling whether user data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for an AI coding tool, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented training opt-out, data-retention control, or no-training guarantee. The enterprise items (SSO, compliance API, managed policy settings) are adjacent controls that do not address training use, and the anti-distillation item concerns poisoning scrapers, not protecting user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
